title: Non-coaxial simple shear against Itskov’s published logarithmic-plasticity curve
source: M. Itskov, On the applicability of generalized strain measures in large strain plasticity, Trends and Applications of Mathematics to Mechanics, pp. 101–113 (2005), doi:10.1007/88-470-0354-7_10, eqs. (45), (60)–(61), Fig. 1, r = 0. Rigid-perfect-plastic additive logarithmic model: tau_xy/(Y/sqrt(3)) = 2 sqrt(4 + gamma^2 + 4 asinh(gamma/2)^2)/(4 + gamma^2).

quantities.quantity: Kirchhoff shear stress at gamma = 1, on the published r = 0 curve
quantities.reason: The unit top face reaction equals tau_xy (J = 1). The 0.005% band covers return integration with delta gamma = 1/512 and finite elasticity Y/E = 1.25e-5; material-point tests check step and rigidity refinement toward the rigid-plastic limit.
